front.title: PSI-08: Receipts for Health Record Access Events

abstract.t:
This document defines PSI-08, a domain profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for access events on health records, recording that an access occurred, by which role, and for what stated purpose. Each record is sealed as a PSI receipt so that later alteration, reordering, or removal is detectable. Only digests are sealed. PSI-08 shows integrity and ordering only; it does not show that an access was authorised, appropriate, or lawful.
Revision 00 carried this title over an abstract describing predicate chains. This revision makes the body match the title.
